name: Eleusinia
summary: The older Eleusinian games for the Two Goddesses — athletic, equestrian and musical contests with gifts of grain — kept in Metageitnion as a thanksgiving for Demeter's corn, distinct from the autumn Mysteries.
testimonia: Rigsby, "The Schedule of the Eleusinia," Mnemosyne 63 (2010) 289–297
Parke, Festivals of the Athenians (1977) 62–63 (Greater and Lesser Eleusinia by Olympiad year)
